spacing.notes: Component spacing 4-24px (8px x285, 12px x138, 24px x128); section containers use 224px vertical padding; keycap internals 14.5px

families: Segoe UI Variable / SF Pro Text (system, inside product mockups)

shadows: navbar: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.15) + border 0.8px rgba(255,255,255,0.06) + backdrop-filter blur(5px)
primary button: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.19), inset 0 -1px 0.4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2), inset 0 1px 0.4px #FFFFFF

taste.name: Accent Off the Controls
taste.trigger: When a strong red brand meets a near-black page where red would pop on any control
taste.decision: Chose to keep red for the logo, hero artwork and one link underline, with a light grey #E6E6E6 primary button and a white 50% focus ring, over red CTAs and red focus states
taste.reason: Because on near-black the brightest object wins: a light button out-shouts any hue, and keeping red rare lets it mean the brand instead of 'press here'
evidence: #FF6363 only in logo and link underline

taste.name: Light Draws the Edges
taste.trigger: When separating cards and the navbar from a #07080A page where black drop shadows disappear
taste.decision: Chose a 0.8px rgba(255,255,255,0.06) border plus a 1px inset top highlight and a 45deg #0C0D0F to #07080A gradient over drop shadows or solid grey panels
taste.reason: Because a thin bright top edge reads as a lit bevel, so the eye finds the container without it lifting off the page
evidence: white surface tints 0.02-0.10 cover ~34% of painted area

taste.name: Rank by Brightness, Not by Hue
taste.trigger: When ordering titles, body, meta and disabled text on a dark ground
taste.decision: Chose a 5-step luminance ladder (#FFFFFF, 0.6 white, #9C9C9D, #6A6B6C, #434345) over colored secondary text
taste.reason: Because readers scan a dark interface by brightness first, so importance is read at a glance and no color is spent on hierarchy

taste.name: Demonstrate the Shortcut
taste.decision: Chose rendered keycaps (11px radius, 4-layer shadow) and inline kbd chips (11px text, 6px radius, inset ring) over icons or prose about shortcuts
taste.reason: Because seeing the exact key to press removes a translation step; the page shows the interaction instead of describing it
evidence: 11px radius x158 with matching 4-layer shadow x158
kbd color rgba(255,255,255,0.6), inset ring rgba(255,255,255,0.2)
